INSERT INTO public.job (job_name, job_category, image, cmd, params, created_by, org_id) VALUES (#{jobName}, CAST(#{jobCategory} AS job_category), #{image}, #{cmd}, #{paramsJson, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.fwdrobo.sirius.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{createdBy}, #{orgId}) RETURNING job_id

,COALESCE(array_agg(ji.input_repo_id) FILTER (WHERE ji.input_repo_id IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS input_repo_ids ,COALESCE(array_agg(ji.output_repo_id) FILTER (WHERE ji.output_repo_id IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS output_repo_ids FROM job j LEFT JOIN job_input ji ON ji.job_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN job_output jo ON jo.job_id = j.job_id GROUP BY j.job_id order by created_at desc
